Part 600 (EPA test procedures) is the closer R101 analogue.

notes: Systemic: (1) summaries of multi-subpart eCFR parts (82, 85, 86) were written from the first subpart/section only and omit the vehicle-relevant content (MVAC servicing, import/recall/warranty, LD/HD emission standards). (2) un_equivalent_ai pairs every NHTSA CAFE part with UN R101/R154 although no UN counterpart exists for fleet fuel economy policy. (3) Part 531/533/536 bodies (pulled 2026-06-01) may be stale after the NHTSA SAFE III final rule published 2026-09-30; the '[Reserved]' precheck flags on 82, 85, 531 are benign (reserved sub-sections/subparts inside live parts). Bodies are genuine regulation text for all 16 items. Titles, citations, source_urls consistent; no effective_date/last_amended/un_equivalent fields present.
